Title: Professional Dental Practice Website with Future Teledentistry Expansion

I am looking for an experienced website designer and developer to build a modern, professional website for my dental practice, 

The website must look customized, polished, and trustworthy—not like a generic template. It must be responsive and function properly on desktop computers, tablets, and mobile phones.

The project will be divided into two phases.

Phase 1: Informational Dental Website
What need to have an allowance time of 2 weeks to add images and video once I complete them but I want the website started
The first phase should include:

- Professional homepage
- About the dentist
- Meet the team section
- Dental services and treatments
- New-patient information
- Insurance and payment information
- Office hours, location, telephone number, and contact information
- Online appointment-request form
- Google Maps integration
- Patient reviews or testimonials
- Links to social media accounts
- Basic local search-engine optimization
- Secure HTTPS setup
- Fast loading and mobile-responsive design
- A content-management system that allows my staff and me to make basic updates

I plan to provide professional photographs of the dental practice, myself, and the dental team. The developer will be responsible for uploading, resizing, optimizing, and arranging these photographs throughout the website. Temporary placeholders may be used until the final photographs are ready.

QR Code and Marketing Requirements

The developer must create a QR code connected to the completed website. I plan to place this QR code on marketing materials and merchandise, including:

- Business cards
- Flyers and brochures
- Cups
- Pens
- Shirts
- Signs and banners
- Other promotional products

The QR code must:

- Direct patients to the correct website or appointment page
- Be tested on both iPhone and Android devices
- Be provided in high-resolution formats suitable for digital use and professional printing
- Include PNG, JPG, SVG, and PDF versions
- Include both black-and-white and branded-color versions
- Remain usable when printed in different sizes
- Be delivered without a watermark
- Not require an undisclosed monthly subscription

Please also explain whether you recommend linking the QR code to the homepage or directly to an appointment-request landing page.

Phase 2: Future Teledentistry Expansion

The website must be designed so that teledentistry services can be added later without rebuilding the entire website.

The future second phase may include:

- Dedicated teledentistry page
- Online patient registration
- Secure intake and consent forms
- Secure uploading of photographs and documents
- Online appointment scheduling
- Secure video consultations
- Online payment processing
- Automated appointment confirmations and reminders
- Integration with compatible dental or patient-management software
- Appropriate patient privacy and HIPAA-related safeguards

Phase 2 will be discussed, priced, and approved separately. Teledentistry features should not be activated during Phase 1 unless I specifically authorize them.

Important Requirements

- Experience creating dental, medical, or healthcare websites is preferred
- Strong desktop and mobile-responsive design experience
- Easy-to-use website management system
- Clear communication and dependable completion times
- Full administrative access and ownership must be transferred to me
- I must receive all website files, design assets, QR-code files, login credentials, and domain-related information
- No proprietary platform or developer lock-in without my approval
- Any paid themes, plugins, subscriptions, hosting expenses, or third-party services must be disclosed and approved in advance
- The website should support future growth, digital marketing, local SEO, and teledentistry

When Applying, Please Provide

1. Examples of dental, medical, or professional websites you have created.
2. Your recommended website platform and why you recommend it.
3. Your fixed price for Phase 1.
4. Your estimated completion timeline.
5. The number of revisions included.
6. What information, photographs, and materials you will need from me.
7. All expected monthly and annual costs.
8. Your experience with QR codes and print-ready marketing files.
9. Your experience with secure healthcare forms, scheduling, video consultations, or teledentistry.
10. A preliminary estimate for Phase 2, listed separately from Phase 1.

projects.title: Python Script for Amazon Shift-Picking
projects.full_description:
I rely on Amazon’s internal shift-picking portal and I’m tired of hammering the refresh key to grab the best slots. I’d like a small Python utility that runs natively on Windows, logs in with my credentials, watches the schedule grid around the clock, and automatically claims shifts the moment they appear.

Core functions
• Automated shift selection – the script should monitor chosen warehouses, dates, and hours, react in real time, and confirm the pick.
• Push alerts – once a shift is secured or altered I need an immediate app notification that lands on my phone; email and SMS are not required right now.
• Change tracking – every accepted, dropped, or swapped shift should be logged so I can review a history of what happened and when.

Windows compatibility is essential, so please factor in any differences with Selenium drivers, headless browsers, or similar tools you prefer. The project should be written entirely in Python; feel free to leverage libraries like Playwright, Selenium, or Requests-HTML as long as setup remains simple (Homebrew install or a single [login to view URL]).

Deliverables
1. Fully commented Python code ready to run on Windows Ventura/Sonoma.
2. Mobile push notification integration (Firebase Cloud Messaging or a comparable service).
3. Local JSON or SQLite log of all shift events.
4. Step-by-step setup guide and a short video or screenshots proving the bot in action on your test account.

I value clean, readable code and would love to discuss rate-limiting, captcha handling, and fail-safe logouts before we start. If you have built similar automation on Amazon or other staffing portals, please mention it so I can see how you tackle anti-bot measures.
